text_source.title: Annals of the Four Masters, Vol 5 English translation
text_source.printed_edition: O'Donovan translated edition vol 5, pp.1259 onward
text_source.original_compilation_date: 17th century compilation of earlier historical materials; NOT 1500s eyewitness account
text_source.content_quality: CELT notes older translation limitations, potential annal chronological displacement and editorial corrections
text_source.copyright: CELT states availability restricted to research and teaching with prior consent; we save original paraphrases+references, not bulk copied original text

actors: Gerald FitzGerald, Earl of Kildare; forces styled English and Irish of Leinster
events.paraphrase_zh: 编年史记述基尔代尔伯爵携伦斯特英人与爱尔兰人出征卡里克弗格斯，拆毁贝尔法斯特城堡，并安排名为‘son of Sandal’者为卡里克弗格斯守堡长官。
events.not_proven: Cannot infer every surrounding Antrim parish under long-term English Crown administration

events.location_historical: three O'Kelly castles: Garbh-dhoire, Muine-an-mheadha, Gallach
actors: Ulick Burke / Mac William of Clanrickard
events.paraphrase_zh: 编年史记载克兰里卡德的乌利克·伯克拆毁奥凯利家族三座堡垒，奥凯利向英王在爱尔兰的代理官求助，随后出现诺克多战役。
events.not_proven: Historical place-name spelling not independently geolocated; do not fake exact coordinates or assign all ruins to English administration

events.paraphrase_zh: 编年史详述基尔代尔集结包括奥唐奈等盖尔地方势力的联合军，与克兰里卡德伯克及汤蒙德奥布赖恩等联盟作战；获胜后赴戈尔韦，再赴阿森里；伯克家族数名子女作为俘虏被带走。
events.not_proven: Battle casualty rhetoric hyperbolic; do not quote as verified count; short-term town possession cannot support permanent county-wide rule

events.location_modern_lookup: Shannon river near Thomond; historical site unverified
events.paraphrase_zh: 编年史记载奥布赖恩家族与两位主教在香农河建造Port-Croisi桥，显示当地拥有可实施公共工程的权力网络。
events.not_proven: Not yet exact bridge latitude/longitude and not necessarily English Crown infrastructural work

actors: Carrickfergus town mayor and castle people
events.paraphrase_zh: 编年史记载尼尔·奥尼尔此前被卡里克弗格斯方面囚禁、以人质换取释放，随后攻取该地大城堡并俘获市长、救出己方人质，表现驻地权力反复变更。
events.not_proven: Castle capture does not date exact duration of occupation; cannot infer all Carrickfergus urban institutions or surrounding Antrim territory under Niall thereafter

events.paraphrase_zh: 奥唐奈家族由厄恩湖水路夺取恩尼斯基林城堡并交给另一支马圭尔家族，向当地首领索取人质、促成和议。
events.not_proven: This is evidence of Gaelic rival government, not British control or a land parcel boundary

actors: Gerald FitzGerald Earl of Kildare, Lord Justice
events.paraphrase_zh: 奥尼尔家族的一方先夺下邓甘嫩城堡，基尔代尔总督军队随后占领奥马城堡、俘获守方人员，并将城堡拆毁后返回；没有长期驻军记载。
events.not_proven: Do not map Omagh as permanently English controlled during entire 1509 or 1510 decade

events.paraphrase_zh: 编年史记载泰隆首领唐纳尔·奥尼尔于8月6日去世，阿特·奥尼尔随后就任，体现当地独立于英王总督的氏族政治继承。
events.not_proven: Do not fill Tyrone all modern county as a single homogeneous Gaelic kingdom automatically, detailed temporal geography remains unknown

review_note: A record of a violent event can have moral historical importance but does not automatically describe a long-lived possession, a complete province-wide English military occupation, nor exact troop/causality count. Check Annals of Ulster and English official records separately.
